headline: IBM Kookaburra: First QEC-enabled module with qLDPC memory + logical processing unit
details: Kookaburra is IBM's 2026 roadmap target: 1386-qubit single module, three modules interconnected via chip-to-chip couplers = 4158-qubit system. First QPU capable of storing information in a qLDPC memory and processing with an attached LPU. Quantum-centric supercomputer blueprint. IBM targeting quantum advantage in 2026.
relevance_reason: 4158 logical-qubit-capable system could run full fault-tolerant MERA. qLDPC + LPU is exactly the architecture needed for scalable holographic circuits. IBM credits program provides academic access path.
access_path: IBM Quantum Credits program (tenure-track academic staff eligible). NERSC IBM Quantum Innovation Center 2026 call for proposals. 180 min free on Open Plan.
